# Overview
A list of all the different [equipment](wiki:equipment) sets. Many sets are not very effective compared to regular individual pieces of equipment and are perhaps more oriented towards lower level new characters.
- Some equipment have When this set is assembled, the following effects are bestowed: with a card or enchant.
- The enchant doesn't have to come from the equipment itself to activate the set bonus.
- Set bonus, whether from equipment, card, or enchant are **only applied once**, even if the player has multiple instances of it.
# Abusive Robe & Morrigane's Manteau Set
When this set is assembled, the following effects are bestowed:
- [LUK](wiki:LUK) + 3
- Additional [LUK](wiki:LUK)+ 1 per upgrade level of **Abusive Robe**.
- Crit + 10
- Additional [Crit](wiki:Crit) + 1 per upgrade level of **Abusive Robe**.
- Bypass 15% of hard defense of Demi-Human, Demon and Undead race targets when performing a physical attack.
| --- | --- | --- |
| Item | Type | Effect |
| [Abusive Robe](item:15147) | [Armor](wiki:Armor) |  |
| [Morrigane's Manteau](item:2519) | [Garment](wiki:Garment) |  |
# Abusive Robe & Valkyrie Manteau Set
When this set is assembled, the following effects are bestowed:
- Max HP + 10%
- Additional Max HP + 1% per upgrade level of Abusive Robe.
- Atk + 2%
- Additional Atk + 1% per upgrade level of Abusive Robe.
- Bypass 15% of hard defense of Demi-Human, Demon and Undead race targets when performing a physical attack.
